answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore the application of knowledge distillation in the context of the creative style-transfer task of conditional humor generation. Given a literal text, the goal is to generate a humorous meaning-preserving paraphrase...

answer_2.quote: We use the LLM-based metric of Win Tie Rate (WTR) also described in Sec 3.2 for automatic evaluation.

answer_3.quote: The critic, an LLM (Large Language Model), evaluates the humor quality of outputs from the finetuned student.

answer_4.quote: In order to validate the role of the teacher as a critic model, we conduct blind human evaluation by some of the authors ("annotators").
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to rank the paraphrases based on how humorous they are and how consistent they are with respect to the meaning of the input.
